text:
Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the minor
maintenance procedure
P1, must be performed
every 5 years Y5 as indicated in the above title block.
Note:
The first draft document initiated by Cairo North substation 220kv, Cairo zone.
Safety Precautions
A
 work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry
 the suitable safety category,
The
 circuit breaker must be isolated completely and grounded on both sides,
Ensure
 that the earthing switch must be connected on both sides of the DS.
Safety fence (rope)
with caution marks surrounding the work area.
Isolate
 the DC voltage.
Wear
 safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glasses.
Before using a
blower to clean the control cabinet or when cleaning the insulators, wear breathing
mask to protect your lung tissues from the dust particles.
Don't
 burn the cloth used in cleaning, collect it and send it to the dump.
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet,
shoes, breathing mask, safety glasses.
Safety fence
(rope) with caution marks.
Tool set
of drivers, screw drivers, cloth, air
blowers, cleaning material (rags, cloth) timing equipment,
Indicator glass (end scope), cleaning fluid, electrical
grease.
Work to be Carried Out
Part no. | Nominal
 Slip Torque
25667 | 8 Nm +20%
 - 10%
T10248 | 4 Nm +30%
 - 10%
Open
the cover and cleaning by Blower.
Check
the functional (closing and opening).
Check
 the gearing running time with motorized operating mechanism (at 100% supply
 voltage) max 2 sec.
d - Align adjusting ring / locking plate bares and in screw in screw T
 10381.
 e - Allow slip coupling to slip 10 rotations in each direction.
Check
 nominal slip torque and again readjust if necessary.
Remove
 slip coupling.
Repeat
 the step no. 3.
Clean
 and grease the operating mechanism.
Make
 visual inspection for the condition of the tubular contact though indicator
 glass.
